title: IS: Infinite Stratos 2 - Infinite Wedding
justification: AniList: 1 episode, 25 min, 2016-06-30, "Infinite Wedding" (IS〈インフィニット・ストラトス〉2 インフィニット・ウエディング; synonym "Picture Drama"). AniDB 9849 S2 "Picture Drama: Infinite Wedding" (2016-06-30); S1 is the 2013 OVA "Hitonatsu no Omoide". TVDB 219131 season 0 0x5 "Infinite Wedding", 2016-06-30, 27 min. The detail's S2 is therefore the right special, the heuristic only lacked the title link. The parent's mapping is Anime-Lists' S1 to 0x2 (wrong) and S2 to 0x2; overlay/9849.json (upstream TODO-PR) rewrites it to S1 to 0x3 and S2 to 0x5, so the bridge depends on that entry; no other node claims 0x5.
